base-skip-to-content: Accessibility skip link at the top of every page; jumps keyboard/screen-reader users past the header to the main content.
base-admin-badge: Small badge shown in the header on admin pages, indicating admin mode. Keep short.
base-log-out: Header button that signs the user out. Lowercase to match the compact header style.
base-admin-link: Header link to the admin dashboard, shown only to administrators. Lowercase to match the header style.
base-log-in: Header link to sign in (Wikimedia OAuth). Lowercase to match the header style.
base-dismiss: Accessible label (aria-label) for the × button that closes a toast/notification.
common-opens-in-new-tab: Visually-hidden suffix appended to links that open a new browser tab, for screen-reader users. Note the leading space.
home-timeline-aria: Accessible label for the small progress timeline on a consultation card showing which input phase it is in.
home-phase-explore: Name of the first consultation phase (voting on statements). Also used in the phase legend and timeline.
home-phase-arguments: Name of the arguments/argument-mapping phase. Used in the phase legend and timeline.
home-phase-informed-vote: Name of the informed-voting phase (a second voting round). Used in the phase legend and timeline.
home-phase-report: Name of the final report/results phase. Used in the phase legend.
home-phase-optin-id: Timeline step where participants may opt in to revealing their identity after a consultation closes.
home-outputs-aria: Accessible label for the grid of output symbols (report, data, etc.) on a consultation card.
home-chip-to-vote: Chip on a consultation card. $1 is the number of statements the user still has to vote on.
home-chip-reveal-today: Chip warning that the identity-reveal window closes today.
home-chip-reveal-days: Chip warning how long the identity-reveal window stays open. $1 is a number of days; 'd' abbreviates 'days'.
home-chip-reveal-opens: Chip noting when the identity-reveal window will open. $1 is a number of days; 'd' abbreviates 'days'.
home-banner-prototype: Top-of-page banner stating the tool is an early prototype.
home-banner-open-issue: Link text in the prototype banner to report a bug (opens the GitHub issue tracker).
home-hero-heading: Main heading on the signed-out landing page. The product's value proposition.
home-hero-body: Sub-heading paragraph on the signed-out landing page describing how the tool works.
home-login-wikimedia: Label on the button that starts Wikimedia OAuth login.
home-dev-badge: Label for the local-development-only login shortcuts. Only visible in dev mode.
home-dev-login-as: title attribute (tooltip) on a dev login shortcut. $1 is a username. Dev-only.
home-open-consultations: Section heading listing publicly-open consultations to signed-out visitors.
home-count-total: Count shown next to a section heading. $1 is the number of items.
home-card-join-aria: Accessible label for a consultation card link. $1 is the consultation title.
home-badge-demo: Small badge marking a consultation as a demo.
home-action-join: Call-to-action on a consultation card to join it. The arrow is decorative.
home-action-continue: Call-to-action on a consultation card the user has already joined. The arrow is decorative.
home-action-view: Call-to-action on a closed consultation card to view it. The arrow is decorative.
home-action-admin: Call-to-action to open the admin panel for a consultation the user moderates. The arrow is decorative.
home-flow-alt: alt text for the diagram illustrating how a wiki-polis consultation flows through its phases.
home-phase-legend-aria: Accessible label for the phase-journey legend diagram.
home-view-mode-aria: Accessible label for the toggle switching between the user's own consultations and browsing all.
home-mode-yours: Toggle button showing the consultations the signed-in user has joined.
home-mode-browse: Toggle button to browse all consultations open to the user.
home-your-consultations: Visually-hidden page heading for the signed-in home page.
home-section-active: Section heading for the user's active (open) consultations.
home-section-closed: Section heading for the user's closed consultations.
home-section-open-to-you: Section heading for consultations the user may join but has not yet.
home-section-moderate: Section heading listing consultations the user moderates/administers.
home-card-aria-pseudonym: Fragment appended to a card's accessible label naming the user's pseudonym in that consultation. $1 is the pseudonym.
home-card-aria-pseudonym-short: Shorter variant of the pseudonym fragment for closed consultations. $1 is the pseudonym.
home-card-aria-remaining: Fragment appended to a card's accessible label with how many statements remain to vote. $1 is a number.
home-card-aria-continue: Fragment appended to an active card's accessible label indicating the action is to continue.
home-card-aria-closed: Fragment appended to a closed card's accessible label indicating it is closed.
home-card-badge-closed: Small badge marking a consultation as closed.
home-card-view-aria: Accessible label for a moderated consultation's title link. $1 is the title.
home-card-admin-aria: Accessible label for the admin-panel link on a moderated consultation. $1 is the title.
home-empty-none-joined: Empty-state text when the user has joined no consultations.
home-empty-none-open: Empty-state text when no consultations are open to the user.
home-output-dialog-close: Accessible label for the button closing the output-details dialog.
home-output-dialog-title: Default title of the dialog explaining why a consultation output is not ready yet.
